options.systemPromptTemplate:
You are an expert resume parser.

Your ONLY task is to convert the provided resume into structured JSON.

Rules:

1. Return ONLY valid JSON.
2. Do not include markdown.
3. Do not explain your reasoning.
4. Do not infer information that is not explicitly stated.
5. If a value is missing, return:
   - null for missing string/number values
   - [] for missing arrays
6. Preserve wording where possible.
7. Do not calculate candidate suitability.
8. Do not score the candidate.
9. Do not compare against any job.
10. Do not hallucinate technologies, companies, projects, certifications, dates or experience.
11. If confidence is low, return null instead of guessing.
12. The JSON structure must exactly match the schema above.
13. Examine/Analyze whole text to get data

messageValues.message:
You are an experienced technical recruiter and hiring manager.

Your task is to evaluate a candidate against a job description.

Rules:

- Evaluate only using the provided information.
- Never invent skills or experience.
- If information is missing, treat it as unknown.
- Compare the candidate only against the supplied job requirements.
- Be objective and consistent.
- Return only the requested structured output.

parameters.subject: =Congratulations! You've Been Shortlisted for the {{ $('Get Job Details').item.json.title }} Position at {{ $('⚙️ CandidateIQ Configuration').item.json.company_name }}
parameters.message:
=

Congratulations!

You've been shortlisted for an interview.

Dear {{ $('Extract Candidate Profile').item.json.output.personal_information.first_name }} {{ $('Extract Candidate Profile').item.json.output.personal_information.last_name }} ,

Thank you for applying for the {{ $('Get Job Details').item.json.title }} position at {{ $('⚙️ CandidateIQ Configuration').item.json.company_name }}.

We are pleased to inform you that, after carefully reviewing your application, you have been shortlisted for the next stage of our recruitment process.

We would be delighted to meet with you to discuss your experience, skills, and how they align with this opportunity.

📅 Interview Details

Position {{ $('Get Job Details').item.json.title }}
Date {{ $json.start.dateTime.toDateTime().format('yyyy-MM-dd') }}
Time {{ $json.start.dateTime.toDateTime().format('HH:mm') }}
Duration 1 Hour
Location {{ $json.location }}
Meeting Link Join Interview
Please Note:
  • Join the meeting 5–10 minutes before the scheduled time.
  • Ensure your internet connection, microphone, and camera are working properly.
  • Keep a copy of your resume available during the interview.
  • Prepare any questions you may have about the role or the company.

If you have any questions or require an alternative interview time, please reply to this email and we'll be happy to assist you.

We appreciate your interest in joining our team and look forward to speaking with you.


Kind regards,

Recruitment Team
{{ $('⚙️ CandidateIQ Configuration').item.json.company_name }}
📧 {{ $('⚙️ CandidateIQ Configuration').item.json.recruitment_email }}


Please do not reply to this email unless you need assistance regarding your interview.
